01 / THE PROJECTA system of connected decisions

Beyond getting
from A to B.

Real crowds do more than follow paths. They wait, react, form groups, and adapt to the people around them.

Our selected features bring together specialized crowd pathfinding, emotion-driven decisions, perception, and group movement in a modular Unity package. Different 3D simulation environments will let us test these capabilities, supported by debug tools and small language models (SLMs).

01

3D simulation environments

Different environments to test the system's capabilities:

  • Evacuation simulation
  • Crowd simulation
  • Medieval War Field
SIMULATION ENVIRONMENTS
02

Resource points & pathfinding

  • Crowd pathfinding with a specialized NavMesh
  • Developer-selectable queue formation at waiting points
  • Templates for points of interest and NPC gathering points
  • Points of avoidance
NAVIGATION & RESOURCES
03

Emotion-driven behavior

  • Emotion templates and character-based behavior
  • Event-based feedback
  • SLM decisions for state transitions
EMOTIONS & DECISIONS
04

Perception

  • Configurable agent field of view
  • Detection of nearby NPCs, objects, and points of interest
  • Awareness of nearby events: fights, hazards, panic, and blocked paths
PERCEPTION & AWARENESS
05

Debug tools & benchmarking

  • Congestion reporting and benchmarking for resource points
  • Logging of utilization, turnaround time, and average time spent
  • SLM congestion detection from logs
DEBUGGING & ANALYSIS
06

Group movement & behavior

  • Making and preserving formations
  • Adapting formations to obstacles
  • Emotion diffusion that influences others in the crowd, especially within groups
FORMATIONS & GROUPS
SELECTED SCOPE

These are the selected features for the project. Implementation details and evaluation results will be documented as development progresses.

05 / WHAT COMES NEXTEvaluation plan

Built to be
put to the test.

We will compare standard NavMesh agents against progressively enabled plugin modules in repeatable scenarios.

Opposing flowsAlternative corridorsCompeting resourcesEvent reactionsGroup movement

Planned measures: travel and waiting time, completion, throughput, congestion duration, and frame time. Results will be shared in the project archive.
